SELECT MAX(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.County = 'Alameda';

SELECT MAX(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.County = 'Alameda';

SELECT MAX("frpm"."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM "frpm"
JOIN "schools" ON "frpm"."CDSCode" = "schools"."CDSCode"
WHERE "schools"."County" = 'Alameda';

SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda';
